<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/evanstonian/room-service">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Room-service call" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="StartEvent_GuestCalls"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Deliver order" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GuestCalls</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_KitchenDispatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholDispatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllReadyJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingTiming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeferBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Billed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GuestCalls" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GuestCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_KitchenDispatch" name="Kitchen preparation and further order handling"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Order wine and alcoholic beverages from sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholDispatch" name="Sommelier preparation and waiter assignment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" name="Alcoholic beverages included?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks" name="Fetch wine and prepare alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Alcohol preparation path merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparation" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Waiter preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholWorkJoin" name="Sommelier and waiter preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AllReadyJoin" name="Food, drinks, and cart ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingTiming" name="Another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeferBilling" name="Wait while preparing or delivering another order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing timing merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Billed" name="Account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Take" sourceRef="StartEvent_GuestCalls" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Take_Submit" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Dispatch" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_KitchenDispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_KitchenDispatch" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Kitchen_AllReady" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_AllReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_SommelierOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_KitchenDispatch" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierOrder_AlcoholDispatch" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholDispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholDispatch_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDispatch" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholYes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Alcoholic beverages are included in the order</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholDispatch_Assign" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDispatch" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_WaiterPreparation" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPreparation_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPreparation_Nonalcoholic" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cart_WaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Nonalcoholic_WaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterJoin_AlcoholWorkJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholWorkJoin_AllReady" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholWorkJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AllReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllReady_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_AllReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_BillingTiming" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingTiming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingTiming" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingTiming" targetRef="Task_DeferBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Another order is available to prepare or deliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling_Merge" sourceRef="Task_DeferBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingMerge_Debit" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Billed"/>

    <bpmn:documentation>About 80% of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
